Enum Class AlgoRecommendationAction

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AlgoRecommendationAction>
grafioschtrader.types.AlgoRecommendationAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<AlgoRecommendationAction>, Constable
public enum AlgoRecommendationAction extends Enum<AlgoRecommendationAction>
What a rebalancing line asks the user to do. The names carry the REBALANCE_ prefix because the frontend translates the stored value itself: a bare BUY would collide with the transaction type texts, which describe a booking that already happened rather than a proposal.

The action is the direction of the trade, not the direction of the exposure. Reducing a short position is therefore REBALANCE_BUY, and the rationale of the line is what says whether the exposure grows or shrinks.

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    REBALANCE_BLOCKED
    The action would increase exposure while the gross exposure ceiling is already breached.
    REBALANCE_BUY
    Acquire units, either to reach a long target or to cover part of a short position.
    REBALANCE_HOLD
    The position is inside its tolerance, or it is a tactical position that no rebalancing may open.
    REBALANCE_SELL
    Dispose of units, either to reduce a long position or to extend a short one.
